prompt:
Precise production sprite edit / supplementary animation keys. Use the provided original farmer as the strict identity, costume, compact proportions, top-down camera and pixel-art reference. Create exactly THREE full-body sprites in ONE horizontal row on a genuinely transparent background, with generous empty separation and no text, no shadows. These three frames will be the OPPOSITE CONTACT in an existing walk cycle. The source reference's right-facing contact poses have the near leg forward; THESE MUST SHOW THE NEAR LEG BACKWARD.
Sprite 1: same farmer facing RIGHT/EAST. The CAMERA-NEAR LEG, attached to the right visible hip, is clearly the lighter indigo denim leg, extends diagonally BACKWARD TO THE LEFT, ending in a large visible LEFT-SCREEN brown boot touching the baseline. CAMERA-FAR leg, darker indigo denim, extends diagonally FORWARD TO THE RIGHT, ending in a distinct RIGHT-SCREEN boot touching the baseline. Both knees and both boots clearly visible, one-pixel minimum gap at native size. The near arm swings forward to the RIGHT, opposite the near leg. This is a grounded walking stride, not a jump.
Sprite 2: same farmer facing AWAY/NORTH, showing back of head and crossed overalls straps. RIGHT-SCREEN leg/boot is extended and planted at the bottom baseline. LEFT-SCREEN knee is visibly raised, with LEFT-SCREEN boot TWO NATIVE PIXELS ABOVE the baseline. Both boots separate horizontally, not overlapping, left and right legs never cross. Right-screen arm swings backward and left-screen arm forward.
Sprite 3: same farmer facing LEFT/WEST. CAMERA-NEAR light indigo leg extends diagonally BACKWARD TO THE RIGHT, ending in a clear RIGHT-SCREEN boot at baseline. CAMERA-FAR dark indigo leg extends FORWARD TO THE LEFT, ending in a distinct LEFT-SCREEN boot. Near arm swings forward to the LEFT. Both boots touching baseline, the two legs distinct.
Every figure matches the first source's exact chestnut hair, sage rolled shirt, indigo dungarees, brass fastenings, brown boots, same scale and stable torso/head. Native design 18px wide by 28px high, crisp square pixel clusters enlarged for clarity, visible tops of head and shoulders. Original attractive GBA farming-game proportions, short legs but readable knee joint and soles. Do not put the near leg forward in either side pose; these frames intentionally depict the OTHER half of the cycle. Do not make extra figures or a new sprite sheet. Transparent alpha, no labels, no ground.
